title: Interface Learnings: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Maintenance fitted what stores bought, and the findings show no one owned the specification between them.

rows: F02 Mechanical Maintenance × F06 Materials Management
F05 Asset Integrity × F13 Plant & Asset Leadership

items.text: A seal passes from stores to the fitters [FND-0003].

items.group: What went wrong at the seam
items.text: The seal had no specification, and the restart had no test to catch a bad part [FND-0003; FND-0001].
The findings show no check by either side [FND-0003; FND-0001].

items.lesson: Stores: a critical spare needs a specification before purchase.
Maintenance: no restart without a leak test, whatever the part.

items.change: Add a specification check at the stores issue counter
items.indicator: % of critical spares issued with a specification reference

items.text: Maintenance planner and stores lead: monthly review of critical-spares substitutions
